title: Utopia Money
description: This mod adds currency to Minecraft to provide the lack of ways of trading.
body:
**Utopia Money** brings currency to Minecraft. Firstly, this mod was created for me and my friends on our modded server. Afterwards, I decided to share this mod for everyone!

This mod adds **six types of currency**:
- 1 Utopia Coin
- 2 Utopia Coin
- 5 Utopia Coin
- 10 Utopia Dollar
- 20 Utopia Dollar
- 50 Utopia Dollar

UM adds also recipes and unrecipes for all types of money.
